entries.title: Foraging drones sharing and stealing energy pods
entries.description: A swarm of small spherical drones roam a bright 3D arena to collect glowing energy pods, leaving colored trails as they either share pods with same-colored allies or collide and steal pods from rival-colored drones, while a central transparent energy tower tracks team scores with rising and falling levels.

entries.title: Predator–prey schools with cooperative defense
entries.description: Flocks of small fish-like particles move in coordinated shoals using alignment rules, while a few larger predator objects chase them; prey cluster into tight, rotating balls that repel predators, and individuals that stray are chased, with trails and changing colors indicating danger and safety.

entries.title: Ant teams cooperating and competing over food piles
entries.description: Ant-like particles emerge from two nests and follow or lay pheromone trails to food spheres, cooperatively attaching to large food pieces to drag them back while colliding and tug-of-warring with rival teams over shared items, with pheromone intensity visualized as translucent colored fog.

entries.title: Cell immune response with cooperative antibodies and competitive viruses

entries.title: Market agents trading and competing on a 3D price landscape
entries.description: Spherical trader agents move over a gently undulating 3D surface representing profit potential, forming temporary glowing links to share price information within teams while colliding with competitors that can “outbid” and push them to less profitable zones, with floating labels showing wealth.

entries.title: Robotic soccer in a minimalist 3D arena
